text: I'm sorry this is long but I'm quite frightened and want to give you everything. My daughter is 7. This evening she's had a temperature of 38.3 and she's come up in a red blotchy rash on her back and arms. I've read about the glass test so I pressed a glass on it, and it does go pale underneath, the redness disappears while I'm pressing. She's breathing completely normally, no trouble at all. Earlier, about 6pm, she bumped her head on the corner of the kitchen table running past. She cried straight away, I gave her a cuddle and some ice wrapped in a tea towel, and since then she's been totally herself, chattering and playing like nothing happened. The other thing that gave me a fright was when I got her ready for bed, her legs were covered in purple marks and my heart stopped. Then her little brother admitted they'd been drawing on each other with felt tips, and it came straight off with a flannel, so that's ink, not the rash. Sorry, I'm just worried that with the temperature, the rash and the bump all together I'm missing something. Is this something I can keep an eye on at home?
